local_mqtt.title: Native local Wi-Fi (experimental)
local_mqtt.description: AquaSky 3 product 532 only. Configure Home Assistant MQTT and explicitly provision the fixture to that same local broker first. Enter the separate Bluetooth and Wi-Fi addresses. Bluetooth is retained as the stable device identity, not used for control in this mode. For an existing device, change its connection in Configure instead of adding it again.

provision_wifi.title: Set up Local Wi-Fi
provision_wifi.description: In FluvalConnect, select Bluetooth control mode, then close the app. Home Assistant uses its Bluetooth adapter or active ESPHome proxy for setup. Enter a local MQTT endpoint reachable by the fixture and connected to the same broker as Home Assistant. Setup replaces the fixture’s saved network and broker settings. Credentials are sent without application-layer encryption and are not saved by this integration.

connection.title: Fixture connection
connection.description: Choose Bluetooth or native local Wi-Fi. Switching preserves entities and settings. Wi-Fi requires separate, explicit fixture provisioning to Home Assistant's local MQTT broker; this form never changes the fixture's broker.

mqtt_options.title: Native local Wi-Fi
mqtt_options.description: Enter the fixture's Wi-Fi address, not its Bluetooth address. Home Assistant's configured MQTT broker is used. Fresh fixture state is read every 30 seconds. This transport is experimental pending hardware validation.

data_description.lamp_profile: Override auto-detection when the wrong model or channel count is shown. Plant and Marine/Reef use their distinct five-channel spectral layouts.
data_description.ping_interval: How often Home Assistant reads from the light to keep the BLE connection alive. Lower values improve reliability at the cost of slightly more radio traffic. Default: 10 s.
data_description.active_time: How long to maintain the BLE connection after the last command. Use 30–600 seconds to disconnect when idle and release the Bluetooth connection for the Fluval app or gateway. Default: 120 s.
data_description.restore_previous_mode: After all exact channel sliders reach zero, wait three seconds and restore the mode used before channel adjustment. Any new channel, power, or mode control cancels the restoration. This may allow the fixture's Auto or Professional schedule to turn the light back on. Default: off.
